label: SA-17(2)
title: Security-relevant Components

statement.prose: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Define security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware; and

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Provide a rationale that the definition for security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware is complete.

guidance: The security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware represent the portion of the system, component, or service that is trusted to perform correctly to maintain required security properties.
